definitions: To successfully complete or deal with a difficult or unpleasant experience or period of time.
To use up or finish a supply of something.
To make contact with someone by phone or other communication device.
To make someone understand or accept something.
examples: She managed to get through the exam despite feeling ill.
We need to get through all this paperwork by Friday.
I tried calling her all morning, but I couldn't get through.
It's hard to get through to him when he's so stubborn.
pastTenses: got through something, gotten through something
